programs.title: NC Medicaid
programs.rationale: The questions the DHB-5200 health-coverage application itself asks, as reviewed in the full-form mapping round (kb/forms/dhb-5200.json): who is applying and for what coverage, household composition, income with its conditional branches, shelter and cost expenses, photo ID, date of birth, citizenship/immigration status, disability, veteran status, and how mail and messages reach the person. Deliberately left out: goal_detail (a free-text navigation note the application has no field for), student_status and received_benefits_before (the printed form does not ask them) — the talk stage still covers every spec question the quick-questions stage does not capture. Added November 2026 (milestone work-requirements): the Medicaid work-requirements questions, adopted as QUESTIONS ONLY from Civilla's user-tested plain-language application insert (https://civilla.org/work/hr1/), are required because of the CMS interim final rule published June 1, 2026 (H.R. 1), work requirements effective January 1, 2027. The DHB-5200 (rev 2020) carries no such fields, so they are collected here so the person answers once; they are NOT linked to DHB-5200 registry fields, and nothing in the app determines exemption or compliance — the state decides. wr_student_enrolled (enrollment full-time or at least half-time) carries the work-requirements student path; the pre-existing student_status stays excluded as before. The screens are household-level, matching Civilla's insert: one applying member's exemption hides the reporting section for the household, and the $580 screen reads the household's captured income — the state decides how exemptions and reporting apply per person, so the app records household-level answers only and never derives a per-person exemption.
